import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Kummer–Vandiver conjecture

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kummer%E2%80%93Vandiver_conjecture)
-/

open NumberField CyclotomicField IsCyclotomicExtension

namespace KummerVandiver

-- TODO(Paul-Lez): change `PNat` to `Nat` once the version of Mathlib we're on allows it.

/--
Kummer–Vandiver conjecture states that for every prime $p$, the class number of the maximal
real subfield of $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_p)$ is not divisible by $p$.
--/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem kummer_vandiver (p : ℕ+) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ¬ ↑p ∣ (classNumber (maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField p ℚ))) := by
  sorry

end KummerVandiver

reformulations.difference: Mathlib's maximalRealSubfield requires an element to be real under every complex embedding, whereas the source uses the usual maximal real subfield of the cyclotomic field embedded in ℂ.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For p>2, the cyclotomic field is CM. Its complex-conjugation automorphism c satisfies φ(c(x)) = conjugate(φ(x)) for every complex embedding φ. Injectivity of φ makes realness under any one embedding equivalent to c(x)=x, hence to realness under every embedding. For p=2 the field is isomorphic to ℚ and is totally real. Thus the subfields and their class numbers agree. The membership equivalence and the corresponding equivalence of universally quantified nondivisibility statements were proved in /workspace/review/scratch.lean without using the conjecture.

sources_consulted: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kummer%E2%80%93Vandiver_conjecture — full article, including background, evidence, consequences, references, and open-problem status.

review.notes: The sole theorem faithfully states p ∤ h⁺ for every prime. PNat.Prime is Nat.Prime on the underlying natural number; the positive-natural and natural quantifications were proved equivalent. classNumber is the finite cardinality of the ordinary ideal class group, with no default-zero issue. Independent Lean checks establish h⁺=1 for p=2 and p=3, and real-subfield degree 2 for p=5. The final scratch file compiles without errors or warnings, and the cited Wikipedia page still records the conjecture as open.
